verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
We wait for You
We wait for You
We wait for You
To walk in the room

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Here we are standing in Your presence
Here we are standing in Your presence
Shekinah glory come down
Shekinah glory come down

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Release the fullness of Your Spirit
Shekinah glory come
Shekinah glory come

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You move and we want more
You speak and we want more
You move and we want more
We want the fullness

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
I can’t get enough of Your presence, presence
I can’t get enough of Your presence, presence
I can’t get enough of Your presence, presence
Can’t get enough, can’t get enough

verse.name: b3
verse.lines:
We want more, we want more
We want more, we want more
We want more, we want more
More of Your Spirit

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
The Lord has given us freedom
Given us freedom, given us joy
